data_description.arbeitspreis: Price per kWh consumed — found on your electricity bill. Also used as a fallback while no statistics exist yet for the dynamic tariff sensor below
data_description.arbeitspreis_sensor: HA sensor providing a live spot-market price (e.g. Tibber, aWATTar, Nordpool) — when set, the unit price is calculated from this sensor's average instead of the fixed value above
data_description.arbeitspreis_aufschlag: Fixed markup added on top of the dynamic tariff sensor's price (e.g. the provider's ct/kWh margin)
data_description.grundpreis: Fixed monthly charge regardless of consumption
data_description.abschlag: Monthly advance payment to your provider
data_description.jahresverbrauch: Estimated annual consumption in kWh — used for cost forecasting
data_description.verbrauch_sensor: HA sensor tracking your electricity meter — enables real consumption tracking and billing forecast
data_description.verbrauch_start_wert: Manual override/fallback: enter the exact meter reading on the contract start date if you know it (e.g. from your bill). Takes priority over automatic detection — useful if Home Assistant's statistics history for the consumption sensor doesn't reach back that far (e.g. after renaming or recreating the sensor).
data_description.einspeiseverguetung: Feed-in tariff per kWh fed into the grid (e.g. for solar)
data_description.bonus: One-time sign-up or switch bonus from the provider
data_description.zaehlernummer: Meter number from your electricity bill
data_description.marktlokation: Market location ID (MaLo ID) or metering point ID from your bill
data_description.preisgarantie: Date until which the unit price is guaranteed
data_description.pv_autarkie: Optional. Applies to the remaining term only: the forecast at contract end and the recommended instalment expect the grid draw of the coming months from the self-sufficiency of the same months last year. Give the total consumption of the house below, or a self-sufficiency sensor, or your own values. Off = the linear extrapolation as before.
data_description.gesamtverbrauch_sensor: Total consumption in kWh as a sensor with a long-term statistic (total_increasing), for example the house consumption of the Energy dashboard. The consumption sensor of the contract must measure the grid draw.
data_description.autarkie_sensor: Alternative to the total consumption: a sensor with the degree of self-sufficiency in % and a statistic (state class measurement), for example the autonomy of the Fronius integration. The monthly mean of last year is used. Not used if the total consumption is given.
data_description.autarkie_manuell: Twelve values for January to December, separated by spaces or semicolons (for example 10 10 25 50 70 80 85 80 60 35 15 10). Used for months without data, and alone if there is no sensor (for example in the first year of a PV system). One value for all months only works next to a sensor, as a fallback.

kredit.title: Loan / financing
kredit.description: Enter the loan the way the contract states it. The rate is optional: without it the integration calculates the annuity from the interest, the term and the final payment. The loan is kept apart from your contracts and does not count in their totals.

data_description.sollzins: The banks calculate the rate with this one. If you leave it empty, the effective rate is used.
data_description.effektivzins: Optional, for information and as a fallback if there is no nominal rate
data_description.laufzeit_monate: Number of months from the start of the contract to its end
data_description.zahlweise: How often a rate is paid
data_description.kredit_rate: Optional. The rate from your contract; empty = calculated. A rate that does not fit the interest is reported.
data_description.schlussrate: Optional: an amount that is still open at the end and paid with the last rate (car financing, residual value)
data_description.erste_zahlung: Empty = one interval after the start of the contract (a monthly loan: the end of the first month). The following payments follow at the interval.
